rules.name: Aura of Infinite Rage
rules.description: Wrath and adjacent friendly characters get +1 Attack while bloodied.

rules.name: Inspire Frenzy
rules.description: A friendly character within 2 and sight takes 2 damage. Boost All that character.

rules.name: Relish The Slaughter
rules.description: When Wrath fells an enemy gain 3 VP and draw a Fate card.

rules.name: Aura of Endless Hunger
rules.description: Nonimmune enemy characters adjacent to Gluttony cannot spend Move points

rules.name: Gruesome Feast
rules.description: Attack 3, Deadly 2, Pierce 1. After this attack resolves Recover X (X= amount of damage the defender received +1)

rules.name: Predator
rules.description: While attacking a Bloodied character, Gluttony may re-roll up to two attack dice.

rules.name: Cruel Cuts
rules.description: After Gouge's attack resolves if the defender received at least 1 damage. Break Any the defender

rules.name: Infernal Hook
rules.description:
Attack 4{4}. After this attack resolves if the defender received at least 1 damage, Pull 4 and Immobilise the defender. 

Note: This is a limited range attack and cannot exceed the 4 range.

rules.name: Lingering Agony
rules.description: Breaks cannot be removed from characters threatened by Gouge except by gaining a Boost.

rules.name: Nova
rules.description: All characters within 4 (including Azrat) take 4 Dice of Direct Damage

rules.name: Ubearable Heat
rules.description: Whenever a character you threaten melee attacks you that character takes 1 damage after the attack resolves.

rules.name: Incinerating Stirke
rules.description: When Azrat declares an attack he gains Pierce X during this attack. (X=the defending characters armor value.) After this attack resolves, if the defender received at least one damage Wound the defender.

rules.name: Dominate
rules.description:
Choose a character of equal or lower rank within 4 and sight. Take an action using that character as if it were part of your force. After that action resolves Daze that character. 

Note: Only applies to enemy characters

rules.name: Enchanting Visage
rules.description: Characters attacking lilith gain Disadvantage and cannot spend Focus tokens.

rules.name: Sanguine Sorcery
rules.description: Lilith takes 1 damage Channel.

rules.name: Grim Harvest
rules.description: Attack a Bloodied character. Moucrum gains Advantage during this attack. After the attack resolves, Moucrum Recovers X (X=amount of damage dealt during this attack +1)

rules.name: Lord of the Deathless
rules.description: Command an undead, regardless of rank

rules.name: Ossifycation
rules.description:
After Moucrum fells an enemy, place an Ossilyte guard into a space the fallen character occupied. 

Note: Take the far left Fate value of that unit as the VP if defeated. (2)

Can only use if there are available Ossilyte models to represent them.

rules.name: Death to LIfe
rules.description: Place an Ossilyte guard into an adjacent space.

rules.name: Drain Essence
rules.description:
Choose an adjacent character. That character takes 3 dice of direct damage. For each damage dealt, Channel. 

(This can apply to allies)

rules.name: Queen of Bones
rules.description: An adjacent Ossilyte guard may perform any action.

rules.name: Calm
rules.description: Break Attack a character within 3 and sight

rules.name: Incite
rules.description: At the end of your activation, choose an enemy character within 3 and sight. That character must activate during its controller's next activation place an objective token on that character.

rules.name: Mind Trick
rules.description: Choose an enemy character within 3 and sight. Sidestep that character as though you controlled them. You may remove a boon from that character.

rules.name: Death's Call
rules.description: Maara gains Disadvantage while attacking Bloodied characters. Bloodied characters gain Disadvantage while attacking Maara.

rules.name: Grave Fear
rules.description: Push 5 and Daze a bloodied or lower ranked character within 3 and sight.

rules.name: The Reaper Comes
rules.description: Place yourself into a space adjacent to a Bloodied character within 3 and sight. you may Daze that character.

rules.name: Impervious
rules.description: Mrawl can take no more than 3 damage during a single Attack.

rules.name: Monstrous Strength
rules.description: After Mrawls attack resolves Push X the defender (X= The amount of damage dealt.)

rules.name: Preferred Enemy
rules.description: When Mrawl is attacking a character with objective token placed by Ektalok, Mrawl gains Advantage.

rules.name: Forsaking Honor
rules.description: While attacking a character threatened by another friendly character, Akturis gains Advantage

rules.name: Unliving Glare
rules.description: Daze and Immobilise a lower cost character within 3 and sight.

rules.name: Incredible Luck
rules.description: After dice are rolled while Akturis is attacking or defending you may change one 0 to a 5 or a 5 to a 0. that die is considered to have been re-rolled.

rules.name: Kiss of Fire
rules.description: Attack 4{4}, Pierce 2 (Wound)

rules.name: Slippery
rules.description: Tiriel can move though characters and does not provoke Attacks of opportunity.

rules.name: Swift Strike
rules.description: While attacking a ready character, Tiriel gains Advantage

rules.name: Twist Fate
rules.description: After dice are rolled during an attack involving a character within 3 and sight. Re-roll and number of those dice.

rules.name: Curse of Ageing
rules.description: Choose a character within 3 and sight. Break Any and Daze that character.

rules.name: Precognition
rules.description: When Aeteranius activates your opponent reveals two cards from their fate hand to you. you may spend {2} to discard one of them.

rules.name: Distracting
rules.description: After B'kta's attack resolves remove a Boon or fate token from the defender.

rules.name: Lead Astray
rules.description: After an attack against B'kta resolves you may place him into an adjacent space. Them place the attacker into space B'kta occupied if able.

rules.name: Skitterish
rules.description: Sidestep

rules.description: Bloodied enemy characters get Accuracy -1 for each Messor Gheist with 2 (Max -3)

rules.name: Disorientating Blast
rules.description: Attack 3{4}. Instead of dealing damage, for each damage Daze or break Any the Defender.
